scope: Author-only offline helper and pure selftest. Root reads complete files before --review. No solver,source,formal-input,program,Git,queue or old-evidence changes.
question: Separate stress-inferred elastic settlement bias from material-kinematic compatibility/bottom-anchor effects in the completed .09375s mode3 window;do not add physical acceptance thresholds.
inputs: Use both sealed longwin numeric_profiles CSVs (1025x100 layers each),frozen config/parameters,run/receipt/completion and existing longwin offline history/selected_profiles provenance. Original all2050 native guards are adopted;no new native decoding or replay of production SPH gradients.
compliance: With original XML E and nu rounded to float32 as production,Delta eps_zz=[Delta sigma_zz-nu(Delta sigma_xx+Delta sigma_yy)]/E and cyclic permutations. Delta is since each own initial effective stress. Double stress averages remain double. Report production constrained modulus and compliance-derived modulus separately;small-rounding differences are not tuned away.
integration: Material-coordinate z0 fixed. Bottom displacement anchor u(0)=0. Constant inferred eps0 from0 to first center .005m,then trapezoid between centers. Predicted positive downward increment=-1000 integral eps_zz dz. Fixed initial cell-edge piecewise-constant integral is also reported;in this uniform center grid its weights coincide with the stated trapezoid,not an independent validation. Left/right constant center-interval alternatives indicate quadrature sensitivity only,not rigorous bounds on an unknown continuous strain field.
decomposition: Keep actual-reference=(actual-stress_integral)+(stress_integral-reference) at every layer/time. Record actual-bottom minus predicted-bottom explicitly,not as a fitted correction. Also record top-minus-bottom differences. Stress-bias regional contributions integrate eps_zz-eps_reference;analytic-reference quadrature error is separate. Top1,top3,top10 overlap;top10+bulk90 alone form a partition.
kinematic_check: Compare stress-inferred mean strain at adjacent centers with -(s[i+1]-s[i])/(1000 Delta z0). This is an offline center-interval reconstruction,not the production corrected velocity gradient and not a new gate. Inferred lateral eps_xx/yy are compliance diagnostics,not directly measured material x/y strains.
outputs: One new800-row CSV at parts256/512/768/1024 for both jobs,one concise four-panel PNG,and small check JSON including last-quarter drift and regional contributions. Bind every actually read data/config/helper/note/manifest and all new output hashes. No overwrite. Root visually reviews PNG before interpretation.
limitations: Small-strain linear elastic inversion of effective-stress increments;no plastic strain. Jaumann rotation is not inverted;actual tiny recorded HG spin is disclosed rather than used to claim exact compatibility. Layer means cannot prove all-particle compatibility. H1 finite-Kw reference is quasi-static,not exact startup truth. No fitted height/time,pressure-baseline substitution,new damping or physical acceptance is introduced. This diagnostic alone does not admit the full consolidation run.
